Definition: Elazar, the name of seven Israelites
BiblicalUsage: Elazar is the name of seven Israelites. In Exodus 6:23, the text says "Eleazar." The life behind the name is told on the Eleazar People profile.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe Elazar matters because God knows His people by name, and Elazar is one of them. That is why I want the name, and the person behind it, kept straight.
